items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I think George Duvivier still lives in that building, yeah.

ctx.x: You and Chester Campbell were talking together and the name George Duvivier came up.

Yeah, well before I moved here I live in Harlem. I lived off of St. Nicholas Avenue on 149th Street and I think George Duvivier still lives in that building, yeah. And of course I lived at the Dorrance-Brooks at one time and that was a house where Lionel Hampton lived and I think he still maintains an apartment there. But now you have two housing projects in Harlem. One named the Lionel Hampton Houses and just recently
